authorization: User requested actual public-data rendering and paper-claim validation on LabServer63.
classification: Dependent release-baseline qualification follow-up to WL19/WL21; no architecture decision or ReST-GI comparison.
scene_mapping_limit: scene1 is the released furnished evaluation scene. Published table does not explicitly identify released function names or MSE color transform; establish image correspondence and report this limitation.
reference: Unmodified scene-native prb/prbvolpath, unlimited max_depth, rr_depth 5
weights: Released pretrained checkpoints only; no retraining, calibration, clipping of HDR measurements, scene/material edits or model changes.
jit_fallback: If notebook virtual-call mode fails, retain failed log, test VCallRecord=true on matching small seed, and label all changed-mode runs. Never silently mix execution modes.
primary_metric: 100*mean((linear HDR neural minus linear HDR PT)^2), RGB, entire image; no exposure normalization or post hoc masks.
secondary_metric: 100*MSE after fixed demo display transform clip(max(x,0)^(1/2.2),0,1), explicitly separate due unpublished paper color-space specification.
noise: Two independent replicates per method; MSE between means and noise floor (MSE(N0,N1)+MSE(R0,R1))/4, plus unbiased cross product mean((N0-R0)*(N1-R1)). Report signed noise-subtracted estimate without clamping.
variance: 128-spp render versus disjoint later high-spp mean of the SAME method; keep bias separate. High-spp reference noise is reported.
timing: Synchronized wall time after one 4-spp warmup; loading/JIT/startup and warmup reported separately; same wavefront flags for both methods; no cross-GPU absolute-speed equivalence claim.
decision: Report numeric ratios and uncertainty, not an invented paper pass tolerance. Exact table reproduction requires matched evaluation configuration, sufficient independent-sample precision and disclosed runtime deviations. Missing precision/configuration is inconclusive, not method failure. Training claims untested.
resource_policy: Single sequential GPU queue, persistent outputs/status. Never stop unrelated workloads. Audit GPU contention at job start/end; watchdog per job 8h. Failures do not overwrite completed artifacts. Start with all-assets 128-spp measurements, then high-spp qualification.
